name: diseased_corpse
description: a Diseased Corpse, a hunched rotting zombie: sickly yellow-green skin covered in glowing yellow pustules and red sores, wild stringy brown hair, white staring eyes and a gaping mouth, a ragged grey-green tunic, a torn brown loincloth with a rope belt, brown rag wraps on his shins, bare yellow-green feet, dirty white bandages wrapped round his LEFT forearm (screen-right), a few small dark flies buzzing round his head, and no weapon: he attacks with the clawed fingers of his bandaged LEFT hand (screen-right)
hands: his weapon is his bandaged left hand on the screen-right side, a clawed hand reaching forward, and his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty clawed hand hanging at his side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the bandaged clawed left hand is lifted up over the head, its claws pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and hunched, the bandaged clawed hand cocked behind the head, the other clawed hand tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the bandaged arm sweeps over the head and the clawed hand reaches out level toward the lower-right
strike.4: contact: the bandaged arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the clawed fingers raking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the other clawed hand swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the clawed hand carries on down toward the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the stringy hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the bandaged clawed hand lifts back to reach forward again

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty clawed right hand flung out to the left, the bandaged clawed arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the bandaged clawed hand dipping, the other clawed hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the bandaged clawed arm flung up, the other arm drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the clawed hands lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the bandaged clawed hand resting on the ground, the other arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the arms go limp, the bandaged clawed left hand flopping open, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the bandaged clawed left hand lies limp and open on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the flies circle above
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes blank, the bandaged arm limp on the ground beside him, a few flies over him
